intro: Pete's instinct — wire WhatsApp (or SMS) to StaffConnect, email, or AI — is valid. The pattern is: pick a channel, pick a trigger, keep humans on anything that commits B9. Start with drafts and one workflow, not a platform rebuild.

patterns.title: Talent FAQ on WhatsApp or SMS
patterns.summary: Talent asks operational questions (pay date, shift details, what to wear). AI answers from an approved FAQ — escalates to a coordinator when unsure.

levels.label: Manual
levels.detail: Coordinator copies FAQ into WhatsApp replies. No automation.

levels.label: Draft assist
levels.detail: AI drafts replies; human sends from phone or unified inbox.

levels.label: Connected pilot
levels.detail: Twilio WhatsApp/SMS + FAQ knowledge base + human handoff queue. 20–30 talent opt-in.

levels.label: Unified inbox
levels.detail: Whippy/Sense-style omnichannel — only after L2 proves value.

gates: No booking penalties from chat usage

patterns.title: Event-day triggers (no-show, standby fill)
patterns.summary: When someone no-shows, blast standby talent with shift details + accept link. AI drafts message; coordinator approves send.

levels.label: Triggered send
levels.detail: StaffConnect status change → Twilio message (with grace period + call first).

patterns.title: Post-event recap → client channel
patterns.summary: Event ends → notes/photos → AI draft recap → human review → email or client-preferred channel.

levels.label: AI draft
levels.detail: Chat workspace draft from bullet notes.

levels.label: Semi-automated
levels.detail: Form/checklist submit triggers draft + review task in inbox.

gates: Human sends all client-facing output in Phase 1

patterns.title: Glue layer (Zapier / Make / webhooks)
patterns.summary: Connect tools Pete already named: new StaffConnect booking → Slack/email alert; new inquiry → draft quote shell in Drive.

levels.label: Light glue
levels.detail: Zapier/Make: trigger on new row, email, or form — output to draft doc or task list.

levels.label: API
levels.detail: Direct StaffConnect API + Twilio — only if L1 proves ROI and API access exists.

vendors.name: Whippy / Sense
vendors.when: After channel validated; omnichannel at scale

vendors.name: StaffConnect API
vendors.when: When exports feel too slow — confirm API access first
